# RadialGradientPaint

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Paints an area with colors interpolated outward from a center point.

`center`, `radius` and `focal` are in the paint's own coordinate space; `transform`, when given, maps that space onto the canvas space where the paint is used. A non-uniform transform is what makes an elliptical gradient expressible - the paint itself carries a single radius.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new RadialGradientPaint(center: Point, radius: number, stops: readonly GradientStop[], focal?: Point | undefined, transform?: PaintTransform | undefined)
```

## Properties

- [`center`](#center): Centre of the outer circle, in the paint's own coordinate space.
- [`focal`](#focal): Optional focal point where the gradient starts; defaults to the centre.
- [`radius`](#radius): Radius of the outer circle.
- [`stops`](#stops): The colour stops, ordered by offset.
- [`transform`](#transform): Optional transform mapping the paint's coordinate space onto the canvas.
